verses.1: And men from the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
verses.2: And the word of Jehovah was to me:
verses.3: These people, these men, set their hearts upon those who were in need. They offered their help to those who were suffering.
verses.4: Therefore, I will speak to them and say to them, “O Lord Yahweh, for every man in Israel who brings his sins before Me, I will take away his sins from him. And I will bring him before the prophet. I, Yahweh, will answer him.” He came with many sins.
verses.5: So that they may understand the house of Israel in their hearts, since it has been destroyed from above by their own actions.
verses.6: Therefore, say to the house of Israel: “Thus says the Lord God: Return and stand on your feet again. From all your sufferings, return your faces back.”
verses.7: For every man from the house of Israel, and from those who live in Israel, I will answer him with My words. I, the LORD, will answer him.
verses.8: And I will face that man, and I will make him my servant. They will know that I am Jehovah.
verses.9: And the prophet shall be exalted, and he shall speak words from me, the LORD. I will raise up this prophet, and I will place my hand on him. Then I will honor him among my people, the Israelites.
verses.10: And they shall carry them as the carrying of a prisoner, as the carrying of a prophet.
verses.11: So that the house of Israel will not be divided among its own people, and so that their sins will not be forgiven. Then I will be their God. May the Lord say this.
verses.12: And the word of Jehovah was to me, “Behold.”
verses.13: Man, you are like the earth; it becomes evil to me when it rises above its proper level. I stretch my hand over it and break off its branches. I send hunger upon it, and I recognize from it that people and animals suffer.
verses.14: And these three men were inside her. Daniel and Iob were righteous in their actions. May they be saved from death, O Lord God!
verses.15: May death and destruction be carried over by you across the land. May they be destroyed, and may they remain hidden from sight.
verses.16: These three men are inside her. May the Lord Yehovah save them, both men and women. Only then will they be saved, and the land will be filled with peace.
verses.17: Or, I will bring destruction upon that land. I will say, “Destruction will pass over this land.” From there, I will know what kind of people and animals live there.
verses.18: And these three men, who are inside her, shall not be saved. May the Lord Jehovah not save them, male or female, for they will be destroyed alone.
verses.19: Or, I will send them into that land. I will pour out my fire upon it in blood, so that no man or animal will survive from there.
verses.20: And Noah and his sons, who lived in his house, said, “O Lord God, if a son or a daughter should be saved through their righteousness, then they will be saved as well.”
verses.21: For as Jehovah said, “Even though I have sent four judgments—poverty, famine, death, and destruction—to Jerusalem, still no one will be saved from them.”
verses.22: And behold, there will be a time when those who have been brought upon Jerusalem will come to you. When they see their ways and their wickedness, then you will be comforted over the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem.
verses.23: And I will comfort you, if you can see your own ways and the wickedness of your ancestors. Then you will know that I did not do all these things out of selfishness. Amen, Lord Jehovah!
